Description

Print a 50 cm-long beam while at an altitude of 580 km, out of a custom polymer material.

Replicator 1 was developed and built in just 4 months and is the first in a series of satellites that will allow us to iteratively develop our technology while taking advantage of the low launch and development costs of CubeSats to drastically speed up R&D.

We’ve already begun working on the next satellite and everything we will learn from this mission will be applied to Replicator 2.
